text:
rachael: Hey team — Rachael here (backend eng, week 1). Quick list: VPN, badge, laptop swap, and infra tokens. Where should I post each of these so I don't spam the wrong people?

samir: Welcome! Short guide: post general setup/help questions in #help. For VPN/badge/hardware ping @it-support in that thread.

taylor: TL;DR cheat:
- VPN & badge -> #help + mention @it-support
- Hardware pickup/desk -> #people-ops or DM the ops rep
- Infra access (aws/infra roles) -> open request via /request-access in #help, then follow up in #eng-infra if needed
- Secrets/tokens -> never in public channels; open a ticket with SRE or use the secure vault link in the onboarding doc

devx-bot: Use `/request-access --service=<service> --reason="onboarding"` to start infra access workflow. Docs: https://internal/docs/onboarding/access

lee: Also: opt into the deploy/devx notifications if you want deploy status — go to #devx-welcome and react with :bell: or run `/notify me deploys`.

samir: A couple of etiquette notes: use threads for follow-ups (so channels don't get noisy), add context + what you tried, tag owners (e.g., @infra-team), avoid @channel unless it's a real outage, and don't paste credentials anywhere. :thumbsup:

rachael: Awesome, super clear. One nuance — where do I post "looking for a pairing buddy" or "need a quick code review"?

taylor: Pairing requests -> post in #eng with a short subject (timezone, tech area). Code reviews -> ping reviewers directly or use #eng-reviews for broadcast asks. If it's onboarding-specific, still post in #new-hires so we can track it.

samir: If it's urgent (e.g., blocker for a release) page the oncall in #eng-oncall with @oncall, otherwise use the channels above.

rachael: Thanks all — I'll file the access request now and opt into the bot notifications. Appreciate the breadcrumbs! :rocket:
